    intro state m hNoDup w₁ w₂ heldMan h₁ h₂
    by_cases hfree : freeMan state.matching m
    · cases hrem : state.rem m with
      | nil =>
          have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
            simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using h₁
          have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
            simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem] using h₂
          exact hNoDup hstate₁ hstate₂
      | cons w tail =>
          cases hheld : state.matching.held w with
          | none =>
              by_cases hw₁ : w₁ = w
              · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
                · exact hw₁.trans hw₂.symm
                · subst w₁
                  have hm_eq : m = heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld] using h₁
                  have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₂] using h₂
                  exact False.elim (hfree w₂ (by simpa [hm_eq] using hstate₂))
              · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
                · subst w₂
                  have hm_eq : m = heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld] using h₂
                  have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₁] using h₁
                  exact False.elim (hfree w₁ (by simpa [hm_eq] using hstate₁))
                · have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₁] using h₁
                  have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₂] using h₂
                  exact hNoDup hstate₁ hstate₂
          | some old =>
              have hchoice :
                  chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = m ∨
                    chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = old := by
                letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w m old) := prefW.decidablePref w m old
                unfold chooseBetterForW
                by_cases hp : prefW.pref w m old
                · simp [hp]
                · simp [hp]
              by_cases hw₁ : w₁ = w
              · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
                · exact hw₁.trans hw₂.symm
                · subst w₁
                  have hchosen_eq : chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld] using h₁
                  have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₂] using h₂
                  rcases hchoice with hchosen | hchosen
                  · have hm_eq : m = heldMan := hchosen.symm.trans hchosen_eq
                    exact False.elim (hfree w₂ (by simpa [hm_eq] using hstate₂))
                  · have hold_eq : old = heldMan := hchosen.symm.trans hchosen_eq
                    have hstate₂_old : state.matching.held w₂ = some old := by
                      simpa [hold_eq] using hstate₂
                    have hw_eq : w = w₂ := hNoDup hheld hstate₂_old
                    exact False.elim (hw₂ hw_eq.symm)
              · by_cases hw₂ : w₂ = w
                · subst w₂
                  have hchosen_eq : chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld] using h₂
                  have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₁] using h₁
                  rcases hchoice with hchosen | hchosen
                  · have hm_eq : m = heldMan := hchosen.symm.trans hchosen_eq
                    exact False.elim (hfree w₁ (by simpa [hm_eq] using hstate₁))
                  · have hold_eq : old = heldMan := hchosen.symm.trans hchosen_eq
                    have hstate₁_old : state.matching.held w₁ = some old := by
                      simpa [hold_eq] using hstate₁
                    have hw_eq : w₁ = w := hNoDup hstate₁_old hheld
                    exact False.elim (hw₁ hw_eq)
                · have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₁] using h₁
                  have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hfree, hrem, hheld, updateHeld, hw₂] using h₂
                  exact hNoDup hstate₁ hstate₂
    · have hstate₁ : state.matching.held w₁ = some heldMan := by
        simpa [proposalStep, hfree] using h₁
      have hstate₂ : state.matching.held w₂ = some heldMan := by
        simpa [proposalStep, hfree] using h₂
      exact hNoDup hstate₁ hstate₂
  have post_preserves :
      ∀ (schedule : List Man) (state : ProposalState Man Woman),
        NoDuplicateHolds state.matching →
          NoDuplicateHolds (postProposals prefW state schedule).matching := by
    intro schedule
    induction schedule with
    | nil =>
        intro state hNoDup w₁ w₂ heldMan h₁ h₂

    | cons m schedule ih =>

  have hInitial : NoDuplicateHolds (openingState fullList : ProposalState Man Woman).matching := by

  have hPost : NoDuplicateHolds (postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule).matching :=
    post_preserves schedule (openingState fullList) hInitial
  have hEq : postProposals prefW (openingState fullList) schedule = state := by

  rw [← hEq]
  intro w₁ w₂ m h₁ h₂
  exact hPost h₁ h₂

  intro _ _ peaks
  
  have hS_ne : ((Finset.univ.image peaks).filter
      (fun a => Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i ≤ a).card)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i₀, -, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ peaks
      ⟨Classical.arbitrary V, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    refine ⟨peaks i₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem peaks (Finset.mem_univ i₀), ?_⟩⟩
    have hfull : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i ≤ peaks i₀) = Finset.univ := by
      ext j; simp [hmax j (Finset.mem_univ j)]
    rw [hfull, Finset.card_univ]; omega
  
  obtain ⟨m, hmS, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image _ id hS_ne
  have hle : Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i ≤ m).card :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmS).2
  
  have hlt : 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i < m).card ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hne : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i < m).Nonempty := by
      rw [← Finset.card_pos]; omega
    obtain ⟨i₁, hi₁, hi₁max⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image _ peaks hne
    have hi₁lt : peaks i₁ < m := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi₁).2
    have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i < m) ⊆
        (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i ≤ peaks i₁) :=
      fun j hj => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hi₁max j hj⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    have hmemS : peaks i₁ ∈ (Finset.univ.image peaks).filter
        (fun a => Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i ≤ a).card) := by
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem peaks (Finset.mem_univ i₁), ?_⟩
      omega
    have hmle := hmin _ hmemS
    simp only [id_eq] at hmle
    exact absurd hmle (not_le.mpr hi₁lt)
  refine ⟨m, hle, ?_⟩
  have hsplit : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => peaks i < m).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => ¬ peaks i < m).card = Fintype.card V := by
    rw [Finset.filter_card_add_filter_neg_card_eq_card, Finset.card_univ]
  have heq : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => m ≤ peaks i) =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => ¬ peaks i < m) := by
    simp only [not_lt]
  rw [heq]
  omega

statement:
import Mathlib


abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

def DistributionFeasible {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ι, pay i ≤ claims i) ∧ (∑ i, pay i) ≤ pool

def AbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  (∀ senior junior : ι,
      senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior) ∧
    (∀ senior junior : ι,
      senior < junior → pay senior < claims senior → pay junior = 0)

def WaterfallExhaustive {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ((∑ i, claims i) ≤ pool ∧ ∀ i : ι, pay i = claims i) ∨
    (pool ≤ (∑ i, claims i) ∧ (∑ i, pay i) = pool)

noncomputable def SeniorClaimsBefore {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

noncomputable def WaterfallDistribution {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

private theorem nnreal_min_add_min_tsub (x p y : NNReal) :
    min x p + min (p - x) y = min p (x + y) := by
  rcases le_total p x with hp | hx
  · have hpx : p - x = 0 := tsub_eq_zero_of_le hp
    rw [min_eq_right hp, hpx, min_eq_left (zero_le y), min_eq_left (le_add_right hp)]
    simp
  · have hpx : x + (p - x) = p := add_tsub_cancel_of_le hx
    rw [min_eq_left hx]
    rcases le_total y (p - x) with hy | hpy
    · have hxy : x + y ≤ p := by
        rw [← hpx]
        simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using add_le_add_left hy x
      rw [min_eq_right hy, min_eq_right hxy]
    · have hpxy : p ≤ x + y := by
        rw [← hpx]
        simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using add_le_add_left hpy x
      rw [min_eq_left hpy, min_eq_left hpxy, hpx]

private theorem sorted_list_waterfall_sum
    {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι] (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) :
    ∀ (l : List ι), l.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b) → ∀ pool : NNReal,
      (l.map fun i =>
        min (claims i) (pool - ((l.filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum)).sum =
          min pool ((l.map claims).sum)
  | [], _, pool => by simp
  | a :: t, hs, pool => by
      cases hs with
      | cons hhead htail =>
          have hfilter_a : (t.filter fun j => j < a) = [] := by
            apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
            intro b hb
            simpa using not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt (hhead b hb))
          have htail_sum :
              (t.map fun i =>
                min (claims i)
                  (pool - (((a :: t).filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum)).sum =
                (t.map fun i =>
                  min (claims i)
                    ((pool - claims a) - ((t.filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum)).sum := by
            apply congrArg List.sum
            apply List.map_congr_left
            intro i hi
            have hai : a < i := hhead i hi
            simp [List.filter_cons, hai, tsub_add_eq_tsub_tsub]
          have ih := sorted_list_waterfall_sum claims t htail (pool - claims a)
          have hfilter_cons_a : ((a :: t).filter fun j => j < a) = [] := by
            simp [List.filter_cons, hfilter_a]
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
          rw [hfilter_cons_a]
          simp only [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, tsub_zero]
          rw [htail_sum, ih]
          exact nnreal_min_add_min_tsub (claims a) pool ((t.map claims).sum)

private theorem seniorClaimsBefore_eq_sorted_filter_sum
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) :
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims i =
      (((Finset.univ.sort (fun a b : ι => a ≤ b)).filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum := by
  classical
  let l := Finset.univ.sort (fun a b : ι => a ≤ b)
  have hfilter_toFinset :
      (l.filter fun j => j < i).toFinset = (Finset.univ.filter fun j : ι => j < i) := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro j
    simp [l]
  have hnodup_filter : (l.filter fun j => j < i).Nodup := by
    simpa [l] using ((Finset.sort_nodup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι))
      (r := fun a b : ι => a ≤ b)).filter (p := fun j => decide (j < i)))
  calc
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims i =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j := by
      unfold SeniorClaimsBefore
      apply Finset.sum_congr
      · ext j
        simp
      · intro j hj
        rfl
    _ = (l.filter fun j => j < i).toFinset.sum claims := by
      rw [hfilter_toFinset]
    _ = (((l.filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum) := by
      rw [List.sum_toFinset claims hnodup_filter]

private theorem waterfall_sum_eq_min
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) :
    (∑ i, WaterfallDistribution claims pool i) = min pool (∑ i, claims i) := by
  classical
  let l := Finset.univ.sort (fun a b : ι => a ≤ b)
  have hpair : l.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b) := by
    simpa [l] using (Finset.sortedLT_sort (Finset.univ : Finset ι)).pairwise
  have hpay_list :
      (l.map fun i => WaterfallDistribution claims pool i).sum =
        (l.map fun i =>
          min (claims i) (pool - ((l.filter fun j => j < i).map claims).sum)).sum := by
    apply congrArg List.sum
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro i hi
    rw [WaterfallDistribution, seniorClaimsBefore_eq_sorted_filter_sum]
  have hsum_pay :
      (∑ i, WaterfallDistribution claims pool i) =
        (l.map fun i => WaterfallDistribution claims pool i).sum := by
    rw [← List.sum_toFinset (fun i => WaterfallDistribution claims pool i)
      (Finset.sort_nodup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) (r := fun a b : ι => a ≤ b))]
    simp [l]
  have hsum_claims :
      (l.map claims).sum = ∑ i, claims i := by
    rw [← List.sum_toFinset claims
      (Finset.sort_nodup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) (r := fun a b : ι => a ≤ b))]
    simp [l]
  rw [hsum_pay, hpay_list, sorted_list_waterfall_sum claims l hpair pool, hsum_claims]

private theorem waterfall_positive_residual_of_positive_payment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (junior : ι)
    (hpos : 0 < WaterfallDistribution claims pool junior) :
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior < pool := by
  have hmin :
      0 < min (claims junior) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior) := by
    simpa [WaterfallDistribution] using hpos
  have hres : 0 < pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hmin (min_le_right _ _)
  exact tsub_pos_iff_lt.mp hres

private theorem seniorClaim_le_juniorSeniorClaims
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (senior junior : ι) (hsj : senior < junior) :
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior ≤ SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior := by
  classical
  let s : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < senior)
  let t : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < junior)
  have hnot_mem : senior ∉ s := by
    simp [s]
  have hsubset : insert senior s ⊆ t := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hx
    simp only [t, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hsj
    · have hxlt : x < senior := by
        simpa [s] using hx
      exact lt_trans hxlt hsj
  have hsenior_eq : SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior = ∑ x ∈ s, claims x := by
    unfold SeniorClaimsBefore
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext x
      simp [s]
    · intro x hx
      rfl
  have hjunior_eq : SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior = ∑ x ∈ t, claims x := by
    unfold SeniorClaimsBefore
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext x
      simp [t]
    · intro x hx
      rfl
  calc
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior =
        (∑ x ∈ s, claims x) + claims senior := by
          rw [hsenior_eq]
    _ = claims senior + ∑ x ∈ s, claims x := by
          rw [add_comm]
    _ = ∑ x ∈ insert senior s, claims x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert hnot_mem]
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, claims x := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
            (fun x _ _ => zero_le (claims x))
    _ = SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior := by
          rw [hjunior_eq]

private theorem nnreal_le_tsub_of_add_le_lt
    (a b c pool : NNReal) (hsum : a + b ≤ c) (hc : c < pool) :
    b ≤ pool - a := by
  have hle : b + a ≤ pool := by
    calc
      b + a = a + b := by rw [add_comm]
      _ ≤ c := hsum
      _ ≤ pool := le_of_lt hc
  have ha : a ≤ pool := by
    exact le_trans
      (by simpa [add_comm] using le_add_of_nonneg_left (show 0 ≤ b by exact zero_le b))
      hle
  exact (le_tsub_iff_right ha).2 hle

private theorem waterfall_positive_priority_of_linearOrder
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) :
    ∀ senior junior : ι,
      senior < junior → 0 < WaterfallDistribution claims pool junior →
        WaterfallDistribution claims pool senior = claims senior := by
  intro senior junior hsj hpos
  have hjunior_lt_pool :
      SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior < pool :=
    waterfall_positive_residual_of_positive_payment claims pool junior hpos
  have hsum :
      SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior ≤ SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior :=
    seniorClaim_le_juniorSeniorClaims claims senior junior hsj
  have hclaim_le_residual :
      claims senior ≤ pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior :=
    nnreal_le_tsub_of_add_le_lt
      (SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior) (claims senior)
      (SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior) pool hsum hjunior_lt_pool
  simp [WaterfallDistribution, min_eq_left hclaim_le_residual]

theorem iso_lemma3 : ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal)
    (hpool : pool ≤ (∑ i, claims i)), ∃ pay : PaymentSchedule ι,
      (∀ i : ι, pay i ≤ claims i) ∧
        (∀ senior junior : ι,
          senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior) ∧
          (∑ i, pay i) = min pool (∑ i, claims i) := by
  intro ι _ _ claims pool _hpool
  classical
  haveI : WellFoundedLT ι := by
    constructor
    rw [← Set.wellFoundedOn_univ]
    exact (Set.finite_univ : (Set.univ : Set ι).Finite).wellFoundedOn
  letI : Fintype (WellOrderExtension ι) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv ι (toWellOrderExtension : ι ≃ WellOrderExtension ι)
  let claimsE : ClaimSchedule (WellOrderExtension ι) :=
    fun x => claims ((toWellOrderExtension.symm) x)
  let pay : PaymentSchedule ι :=
    fun i => WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool (toWellOrderExtension i)
  refine ⟨pay, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hcap :
        WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool (toWellOrderExtension i) ≤
          claimsE (toWellOrderExtension i) := by
      exact min_le_left _ _
    simpa [pay, claimsE, WaterfallDistribution] using hcap
  · intro senior junior hsj hpos
    have hsjE :
        (toWellOrderExtension senior : WellOrderExtension ι) < toWellOrderExtension junior :=
      toWellOrderExtension_strictMono hsj
    have hposE :
        0 < WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool (toWellOrderExtension junior) := by
      simpa [pay] using hpos
    have hpriority :=
      waterfall_positive_priority_of_linearOrder claimsE pool
        (toWellOrderExtension senior) (toWellOrderExtension junior) hsjE hposE
    simpa [pay, claimsE] using hpriority
  · have hsumE :
        (∑ x : WellOrderExtension ι, WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool x) =
          min pool (∑ x : WellOrderExtension ι, claimsE x) :=
      waterfall_sum_eq_min claimsE pool
    have hleft :
        (∑ i : ι, pay i) =
          ∑ x : WellOrderExtension ι, WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool x := by
      simpa [pay] using
        (Equiv.sum_comp (toWellOrderExtension : ι ≃ WellOrderExtension ι)
          (fun x : WellOrderExtension ι => WaterfallDistribution claimsE pool x))
    have hclaims :
        (∑ x : WellOrderExtension ι, claimsE x) = ∑ i : ι, claims i := by

abbrev CechDescentDatum {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}

def CechClass {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w})
    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) : CechH1 𝔘 G :=
  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.class g

def IsTrivialCechClass {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) (η : CechH1 𝔘 G) : Prop :=
  η = 1

def IsCoboundary {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w})
    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : PresheafOfGroups.ZeroCochain G 𝔘.U,
    PresheafOfGroups.OneCohomologyRelation

    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) where
  globalTrivialization : PresheafOfGroups.ZeroCochain G 𝔘.U

    PresheafOfGroups.OneCohomologyRelation

    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) : Prop :=

/--
Let $S$ be a finite set. A set $P$ of subsets of $S$ has the property that any two members of $P$ have at least one element in common and that $P$ cannot be extended (whilst keeping this property). Prove that $P$ contains exactly half of the subsets of $S$.
-/

theorem putnam_1964_b2 (S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hInt : (P : Set (Set S)).Intersecting := by
    intro T hT U hU hdisj
    exact hPP T hT U hU (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hdisj)
  have hMax :
      ∀ Q : Finset (Set S), (Q : Set (Set S)).Intersecting → P ⊆ Q → P = Q := by
    intro Q hQ hPQ
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
    intro T hTQ
    by_contra hTP
    have hall : ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
      intro U hUP hTU
      exact hQ hTQ (hPQ hUP) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr hTU)
    exact hPS ⟨T, hTP, hall⟩
  have hhalf : 2 * P.card = Fintype.card (Set S) :=
    (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hInt).1 hMax
  rw [Fintype.card_set] at hhalf
  have hSpos : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos
  have hpow : 2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 * 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hSpos]
    rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
    rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one]
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos (hhalf.trans hpow)

    by_cases huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).Nonempty

        Finset.exists_max_image (Finset.univ : Finset ι) rank huniv

          (Finset.univ.filter fun i : ι => rank i ≤ rank m) = Finset.univ := by

        simp [hmax i (Finset.mem_univ i)]

        exact Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp huniv

        have hsum_zero : (∑ i : ι, claims i) = 0 := by
          simp [huniv_empty]

      simp [cumulative, hpool_zero]
  let k : ℕ := Nat.find hcut_exists
  have hcut : pool ≤ cumulative k := Nat.find_spec hcut_exists
  have hlower_le_pool :
      (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun i : ι => rank i < k), claims i) ≤ pool := by

            (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun i : ι => rank i = k), claims i) := hsplit
      _ =

    · by_cases heq : rank i = k

            (pool -

      simpa [hsum_pay] using
        add_tsub_cancel_of_le
          (a := ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun i : ι => rank i < k), claims i)
          (b := pool) hlower_le_pool
    have hmin : min pool (∑ i : ι, claims i) = pool := min_eq_left hpool

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ senior junior : ι, senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior

  ∃ senior junior : ι, senior < junior ∧ 0 < pay junior

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop where

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

lemma exists_payment_le_sum_finset {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (claims : ι → NNReal) (pool : NNReal)

    ∃ pay : ι → NNReal, (∀ i : ι, pay i ≤ claims i) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ s, pay i) = pool := by
  classical
  revert pool
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?empty ?insert
  · intro pool hpool
    have hpool_zero : pool = 0 := le_antisymm hpool (zero_le pool)
    refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact zero_le (claims i)
    · simp [hpool_zero]
  · intro a s ha ih pool hpool
    by_cases hfirst : pool ≤ claims a
    · refine ⟨fun i => if i = a then pool else 0, ?_, ?_⟩

      refine ⟨fun i => if i = a then claims a else pay i, ?_, ?_⟩

        · simpa [hi] using hpay_cap i

          intro x hx
          have hxa : x ≠ a := by

            exact ha (by simpa [hxa] using hx)
          simp [hxa]
        simp [Finset.sum_insert, ha, hsum_if, hpay_sum,

  · by_cases heq : rank i = k

    · have hnle : ¬ rank i ≤ k := by omega

    (∑ i : ι, (if rank i < k then claims i else if rank i = k then bucketPay i else 0)) =

structure FiniteCover {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) where
  I : Type w'
  finite : Fintype I
  X : C
  U : I → C
  mapToBase : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X
  covers : Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows U mapToBase) ∈ J X

abbrev CechDescentDatum {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) : Type _ :=
  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle G 𝔘.U

abbrev CechH1 {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) : Type _ :=
  PresheafOfGroups.H1 G 𝔘.U

def CechClass {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w})
    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) : CechH1 𝔘 G :=
  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.class g

    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) (η : CechH1 𝔘 G) : Prop :=

def IsCoboundary {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w})
    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : PresheafOfGroups.ZeroCochain G 𝔘.U,
    PresheafOfGroups.OneCohomologyRelation
      (1 : PresheafOfGroups.OneCochain G 𝔘.U) g.toOneCochain h

structure EffectiveDescentDatum {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}

    (g : CechDescentDatum 𝔘 G) where
  globalTrivialization : PresheafOfGroups.ZeroCochain G 𝔘.U

    (𝔘 : FiniteCover J) (G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w})

theorem cyclic_exact_sum_zero : ∀ {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G]
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (h : ZMod n → G),
    (∑ i : ZMod n, (h (i + 1) - h i)) = 0 := by

  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

    refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod n)) _ _ ?_

    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (g : ZMod n → G), (∑ i : ZMod n, g i) ≠ 0 →
      ¬ ∃ h : ZMod n → G, ∀ i : ZMod n, g i = h (i + 1) - h i := by
  intro G _ n _ g hsum hglobal
  rcases hglobal with ⟨h, hh⟩
  have hsumzero : (∑ i : ZMod n, g i) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : ZMod n, g i) = ∑ i : ZMod n, (h (i + 1) - h i) := by
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hh i)

abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

                                                                    

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

                                                                           

def DistributionFeasible {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : ι, pay i ≤ claims i) ∧ (∑ i, pay i) ≤ pool

                                                                           
             

def AbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ senior junior : ι, senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior

                                                                      
                            

def APRTriggered {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∃ senior junior : ι, senior < junior ∧ 0 < pay junior

                                                                              
                           

structure NonvacuousAbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop where
  apr : AbsolutePriority claims pay
  triggered : APRTriggered pay

                                                                                 

noncomputable def SeniorClaimsBefore {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

                                                                              
                                            

noncomputable def WaterfallDistribution {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

  absolute_priority : AbsolutePriority claims pay

  constructor
  · intro i hi

    have hmem_junior : senior ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < junior) := by

by
  intro Man Woman _ _ _ _ prefW fullList schedule state hRun
  let P : ProposalState Man Woman → Prop :=
    fun st =>
      ∀ {m : Man} {w : Woman},
        w ∈ fullList m →
          w ∉ st.rem m →
            st.matching.held w ≠ some m →
              ∃ held : Man, st.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m
  have hChooseKeepsBelow :
      ∀ (w : Woman) (incoming old rejected : Man),
        prefW.pref w old rejected →
          prefW.pref w (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) rejected := by
    intro w incoming old rejected hOld
    unfold chooseBetterForW
    letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w incoming old) :=
      prefW.decidablePref w incoming old
    by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
    · simp [h, prefW.trans w h hOld]
    · simp [h, hOld]
  have hChooseRejectsIncoming :
      ∀ (w : Woman) (incoming old : Man),
        (some (chooseBetterForW prefW w incoming old) ≠ some incoming) →
          prefW.pref w old incoming := by
    intro w incoming old hNe
    have hOldNeIncoming : old ≠ incoming := by
      intro hEq
      apply hNe
      subst old
      simp [chooseBetterForW, prefW.irrefl]
    by_cases h : prefW.pref w incoming old
    · exact False.elim (hNe (by simp [chooseBetterForW, h]))
    · have hTotal := prefW.total w hOldNeIncoming
      rcases hTotal with hOldIncoming | hIncomingOld
      · exact hOldIncoming
      · exact False.elim (h hIncomingOld)
  have hInit : P (openingState fullList) := by
    intro m w hFull hNotRem _hHeld
    exact False.elim (hNotRem hFull)
  have hStep : ∀ (st : ProposalState Man Woman) (actor : Man),
      P st → P (proposalStep prefW st actor) := by
    intro st actor hP
    intro m w hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
    by_cases hFree : freeMan st.matching actor
    · cases hRem : st.rem actor with
      | nil =>
          simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem] using
            (hP hFull
              (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem] using hNotRem)
              (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem] using hHeldNe))
      | cons target tail =>
          by_cases hm : m = actor
          · subst actor
            by_cases hw : w = target
            · subst target
              cases hTargetHeld : st.matching.held w with
              | none =>
                  have hNext : some m ≠ some m := by
                    simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld] using hHeldNe
                  exact False.elim (hNext rfl)
              | some old =>
                  have hChoiceOld : chooseBetterForW prefW w m old = old := by
                    by_cases h : prefW.pref w m old
                    · have hBad : (proposalStep prefW st m).matching.held w ≠ some m := hHeldNe
                      have hEqNext : (proposalStep prefW st m).matching.held w = some m := by
                        simp [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld,
                          chooseBetterForW, h]
                      exact False.elim (hBad hEqNext)
                    · simp [chooseBetterForW, h]
                  refine ⟨old, ?_, ?_⟩
                  · simp [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld, hChoiceOld]
                  · exact hChooseRejectsIncoming w m old
                      (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld] using hHeldNe)
            · have hNotRemBefore : w ∉ st.rem m := by
                rw [hRem]
                intro hMem
                simp only [List.mem_cons] at hMem
                rcases hMem with hEq | hTail
                · exact hw hEq
                · exact hNotRem (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem] using hTail)
              simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, updateHeld, hw] using
                (hP hFull hNotRemBefore
                  (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, updateHeld, hw] using hHeldNe))
          · by_cases hw : w = target
            · subst target
              cases hTargetHeld : st.matching.held w with
              | none =>
                  have hNextHeld : (proposalStep prefW st actor).matching.held w = some actor := by
                    simp [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld]
                  have hActorNeM : actor ≠ m := by
                    intro hEq
                    exact hm hEq.symm
                  refine ⟨actor, hNextHeld, ?_⟩
                  have hOldContradiction :
                      ∃ held : Man, st.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m :=
                    hP hFull
                      (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, Function.update, hm] using hNotRem)
                      (by simp [hTargetHeld])
                  rcases hOldContradiction with ⟨held, hHeld, _⟩
                  simp [hTargetHeld] at hHeld
              | some old =>
                  by_cases hOldM : old = m
                  · subst old
                    have hActorPref : prefW.pref w actor m := by
                      by_cases h : prefW.pref w actor m
                      · exact h
                      · have hBad : some m ≠ some m := by
                          simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld,
                            chooseBetterForW, h] using hHeldNe
                        exact False.elim (hBad rfl)
                    refine ⟨actor, ?_, hActorPref⟩
                    · simp [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld,
                        chooseBetterForW, hActorPref]
                  · have hOldBelow :
                        ∃ held : Man, st.matching.held w = some held ∧ prefW.pref w held m :=
                      hP hFull
                        (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, Function.update, hm] using hNotRem)
                        (by simpa [hTargetHeld, hOldM])
                    rcases hOldBelow with ⟨held, hHeld, hPref⟩
                    have hHeldEq : held = old := by
                      rw [hTargetHeld] at hHeld
                      exact (Option.some.inj hHeld).symm
                    refine ⟨chooseBetterForW prefW w actor old, ?_, ?_⟩
                    · simp [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, hTargetHeld, updateHeld]
                    · apply hChooseKeepsBelow
                      simpa [hHeldEq] using hPref
            · simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, updateHeld, hw] using
                (hP hFull
                  (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, Function.update, hm] using hNotRem)
                  (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree, hRem, updateHeld, hw] using hHeldNe))
    · simpa [proposalStep, hFree] using
        (hP hFull
          (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree] using hNotRem)
          (by simpa [proposalStep, hFree] using hHeldNe))
  have hFold : ∀ (xs : List Man) (st : ProposalState Man Woman),
      P st → P (xs.foldl (proposalStep prefW) st) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro st hP
        intro m w hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
        exact hP hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
    | cons actor rest ih =>
        intro st hP
        intro m w hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
        exact ih (proposalStep prefW st actor) (hStep st actor hP) hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
  unfold ProposalRun at hRun
  subst state
  intro m w hFull hNotRem hHeldNe
  exact (hFold schedule (openingState fullList) hInit) hFull
    (by simpa [postProposals] using hNotRem)
    (by simpa [postProposals] using hHeldNe)

import Mathlib


abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

def AbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ senior junior : ι, senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior

noncomputable def SeniorClaimsBefore {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

noncomputable def WaterfallDistribution {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

theorem iso_lemma1 : ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (junior : ι)
    (hpos : 0 < WaterfallDistribution claims pool junior), SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior < pool := by
  intro ι _ _ claims pool junior hpos
  have hmin :
      0 < min (claims junior) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior) := by
    simpa [WaterfallDistribution] using hpos
  have hres : 0 < pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hmin (min_le_right _ _)
  exact tsub_pos_iff_lt.mp hres

proof:
by
  intro fee p dx hp hfee hdx
  let q : ConstantProductPool :=
    swapYToX fee.gamma (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx) (amountOutXToY fee.gamma p dx)
  have h_first_wf : PoolWellFormed (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx) := by
    rcases hp with ⟨hx, hy⟩
    constructor
    · change 0 < p.reserveX + dx
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le dx))
    · change 0 < p.reserveX * p.reserveY / (p.reserveX + fee.gamma * dx)
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hx hy)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le (fee.gamma * dx))))
  have h_swapX_prod :
      poolProduct p < poolProduct (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx) := by
    rcases hp with ⟨hx, hy⟩
    dsimp [poolProduct, swapXToY]
    let d : NNReal := p.reserveX + fee.gamma * dx
    have hd_pos : 0 < d := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le (fee.gamma * dx)))
    have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd_pos
    have hgamma_mul : fee.gamma * dx < dx := by
      simpa using (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hfee hdx)
    have hd_lt : d < p.reserveX + dx := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [add_comm] using add_lt_add_left hgamma_mul p.reserveX
    have hquot_pos : 0 < p.reserveX * p.reserveY / d := by
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hx hy) hd_pos
    calc
      p.reserveX * p.reserveY = d * (p.reserveX * p.reserveY / d) := by
        exact (mul_div_cancel₀ (p.reserveX * p.reserveY) hd_ne).symm
      _ < (p.reserveX + dx) * (p.reserveX * p.reserveY / d) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hd_lt hquot_pos
  have h_swapY_prod :
      poolProduct (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx) ≤ poolProduct q := by
    rcases h_first_wf with ⟨_hx, hy⟩
    dsimp [q, poolProduct, swapYToX]
    let dy : NNReal := amountOutXToY fee.gamma p dx
    let d : NNReal := (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY + fee.gamma * dy
    have hd_pos : 0 < d := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy (le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le (fee.gamma * dy)))
    have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd_pos
    have hgamma_mul : fee.gamma * dy ≤ dy := by
      simpa using (mul_le_mul_right' fee.gamma_le_one dy)
    have hd_le : d ≤ (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY + dy := by
      dsimp [d]
      simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hgamma_mul (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY
    calc
      (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX * (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY =
          ((swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX * (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY / d) * d := by
        simpa [mul_comm] using
          (mul_div_cancel₀
            ((swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX * (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY)
            hd_ne).symm
      _ ≤ ((swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX * (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY / d) *
          ((swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY + dy) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_left' hd_le
          ((swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX * (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY / d)
  have hprod : poolProduct p < poolProduct q := lt_of_lt_of_le h_swapX_prod h_swapY_prod
  have h_first_y_le : (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveY ≤ p.reserveY := by
    dsimp [swapXToY]
    let d : NNReal := p.reserveX + fee.gamma * dx
    have hd_pos : 0 < d := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le (fee.gamma * dx)))
    have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd_pos
    have hx_le_d : p.reserveX ≤ d := by
      dsimp [d]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (zero_le (fee.gamma * dx))
    calc
      p.reserveX * p.reserveY / d ≤ d * p.reserveY / d := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_right' hx_le_d p.reserveY) (zero_le d)
      _ = p.reserveY := by
        exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ p.reserveY hd_ne
  have hyq : q.reserveY ≤ p.reserveY := by
    dsimp [q, swapYToX, amountOutXToY]
    exact le_of_eq (by rw [add_comm, tsub_add_cancel_of_le h_first_y_le])
  have h_final_x : p.reserveX < q.reserveX := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hxq : q.reserveX ≤ p.reserveX := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hprod_le : q.reserveX * q.reserveY ≤ p.reserveX * p.reserveY := by
      exact mul_le_mul hxq hyq (zero_le q.reserveY) (zero_le p.reserveX)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hprod_le) (by simpa [poolProduct] using hprod)
  have hreturn : (swapXToY fee.gamma p dx).reserveX - q.reserveX < dx := by
    dsimp [swapXToY]
    calc
      p.reserveX + dx - q.reserveX =
          p.reserveX + dx - (p.reserveX + (q.reserveX - p.reserveX)) := by
        rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le h_final_x.le]
      _ = dx - (q.reserveX - p.reserveX) := by
        rw [add_tsub_add_eq_tsub_left]
      _ < dx := tsub_lt_self hdx (tsub_pos_of_lt h_final_x)
  dsimp [roundTripXReturn, amountOutYToX, q]
  simpa [q] using hreturn

proof:
by
  intro h
  let S : ℝ := r1 + r2
  let T : ℝ := r3 + r4
  let P : ℝ := r1 * r2
  let Q : ℝ := r3 * r4
  let std : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 4 + Polynomial.C (b : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
      Polynomial.C (c : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (d : ℝ) * Polynomial.X +
        Polynomial.C (e : ℝ)
  let roots : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r1) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r2) *
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r3) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r4)
  let grouped : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) *
      ((Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q))
  have haR : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ane0
  have hpoly : std = roots := by
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro z
    dsimp [std, roots]
    have h1 := hf1 z
    have h2 := hf2 z
    simp [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub]
    rw [← h1, ← h2]
  have hgroup : roots = grouped := by
    dsimp [roots, grouped, S, T, P, Q]
    simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    ring_nf
  have coeff_std3 : std.coeff 3 = (b : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_std2 : std.coeff 2 = (c : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_std1 : std.coeff 1 = (d : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_group3 : grouped.coeff 3 = - (a : ℝ) * (S + T) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have coeff_group2 : grouped.coeff 2 = (a : ℝ) * (P + Q + S * T) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have coeff_group1 : grouped.coeff 1 = - (a : ℝ) * (S * Q + T * P) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have h3 : (b : ℝ) = - (a : ℝ) * (S + T) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 3) hpoly
    change std.coeff 3 = roots.coeff 3 at this
    rw [coeff_std3, hgroup, coeff_group3] at this
    exact this
  have h2 : (c : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (P + Q + S * T) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 2) hpoly
    change std.coeff 2 = roots.coeff 2 at this
    rw [coeff_std2, hgroup, coeff_group2] at this
    exact this
  have h1 : (d : ℝ) = - (a : ℝ) * (S * Q + T * P) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 1) hpoly
    change std.coeff 1 = roots.coeff 1 at this
    rw [coeff_std1, hgroup, coeff_group1] at this
    exact this
  have hST : S + T = - (b : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [h3]
    field_simp [haR]
  have hUexpr : P + Q = (c : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) - S * T := by
    rw [h2]
    field_simp [haR]
    ring
  have hVexpr : S * Q + T * P = - (d : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [h1]
    field_simp [haR]
  rcases exists_rat_of_not_irrational h.1 with ⟨sRat, hsRat⟩
  let totalRat : ℚ := - (b : ℚ) / (a : ℚ)
  let tRat : ℚ := totalRat - sRat
  let uRat : ℚ := (c : ℚ) / (a : ℚ) - sRat * tRat
  let vRat : ℚ := - (d : ℚ) / (a : ℚ)
  have hSrat : S = (sRat : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [S]
    exact hsRat
  have hTotalRat : S + T = (totalRat : ℝ) := by
    rw [hST]
    dsimp [totalRat]
    norm_num
  have hTrat : T = (tRat : ℝ) := by
    calc
      T = S + T - S := by ring
      _ = (totalRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) := by rw [hTotalRat, hSrat]
      _ = (tRat : ℝ) := by simp [tRat]
  have hUrat : P + Q = (uRat : ℝ) := by
    calc
      P + Q = (c : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) - S * T := hUexpr
      _ = (c : ℚ) / (a : ℚ) - sRat * tRat := by
        rw [hSrat, hTrat]
        norm_num
      _ = (uRat : ℝ) := by simp [uRat]
  have hVrat : S * Q + T * P = (vRat : ℝ) := by
    rw [hVexpr]

/--
Let $f(z)=az^4+bz^3+cz^2+dz+e=a(z-r_1)(z-r_2)(z-r_3)(z-r_4)$ where $a,b,c,d,e$ are integers, $a \neq 0$. Show that if $r_1+r_2$ is a rational number and $r_1+r_2 \neq r_3+r_4$, then $r_1r_2$ is a rational number.
-/

theorem putnam_2003_b4
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (a b c d e : ℤ)
  (r1 r2 r3 r4 : ℝ)
  (ane0 : a ≠ 0)
  (hf1 : ∀ z, f z = a * z ^ 4 + b * z ^ 3 + c * z ^ 2 + d * z + e)
  (hf2 : ∀ z, f z = a * (z - r1) * (z - r2) * (z - r3) * (z - r4)) :
  (¬Irrational (r1 + r2) ∧ r1 + r2 ≠ r3 + r4) → ¬Irrational (r1 * r2) := by
  intro h
  let S : ℝ := r1 + r2
  let T : ℝ := r3 + r4
  let P : ℝ := r1 * r2
  let Q : ℝ := r3 * r4
  let std : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 4 + Polynomial.C (b : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
      Polynomial.C (c : ℝ) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (d : ℝ) * Polynomial.X +
        Polynomial.C (e : ℝ)
  let roots : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r1) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r2) *
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r3) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C r4)
  let grouped : Polynomial ℝ :=
    Polynomial.C (a : ℝ) *
      ((Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q))
  have haR : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ane0
  have hpoly : std = roots := by
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro z
    dsimp [std, roots]
    have h1 := hf1 z
    have h2 := hf2 z
    simp [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_sub]
    rw [← h1, ← h2]
  have hgroup : roots = grouped := by
    dsimp [roots, grouped, S, T, P, Q]
    simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    ring_nf
  have coeff_std3 : std.coeff 3 = (b : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_std2 : std.coeff 2 = (c : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_std1 : std.coeff 1 = (d : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [std]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  have coeff_group3 : grouped.coeff 3 = - (a : ℝ) * (S + T) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have coeff_group2 : grouped.coeff 2 = (a : ℝ) * (P + Q + S * T) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have coeff_group1 : grouped.coeff 1 = - (a : ℝ) * (S * Q + T * P) := by
    dsimp [grouped]
    rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C S * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C P) *
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C T * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C Q) =
        Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C (S + T) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
          Polynomial.C (P + Q + S * T) * Polynomial.X ^ 2 -
          Polynomial.C (S * Q + T * P) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (P * Q) by
      simp [map_add, map_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]
      ring_nf]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C, mul_ite, mul_one,
      mul_zero]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num at * <;> ring_nf
  have h3 : (b : ℝ) = - (a : ℝ) * (S + T) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 3) hpoly
    change std.coeff 3 = roots.coeff 3 at this
    rw [coeff_std3, hgroup, coeff_group3] at this
    exact this
  have h2 : (c : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) * (P + Q + S * T) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 2) hpoly
    change std.coeff 2 = roots.coeff 2 at this
    rw [coeff_std2, hgroup, coeff_group2] at this
    exact this
  have h1 : (d : ℝ) = - (a : ℝ) * (S * Q + T * P) := by
    have := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.coeff 1) hpoly
    change std.coeff 1 = roots.coeff 1 at this
    rw [coeff_std1, hgroup, coeff_group1] at this
    exact this
  have hST : S + T = - (b : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [h3]
    field_simp [haR]
  have hUexpr : P + Q = (c : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) - S * T := by
    rw [h2]
    field_simp [haR]
    ring
  have hVexpr : S * Q + T * P = - (d : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) := by
    rw [h1]
    field_simp [haR]
  rcases exists_rat_of_not_irrational h.1 with ⟨sRat, hsRat⟩
  let totalRat : ℚ := - (b : ℚ) / (a : ℚ)
  let tRat : ℚ := totalRat - sRat
  let uRat : ℚ := (c : ℚ) / (a : ℚ) - sRat * tRat
  let vRat : ℚ := - (d : ℚ) / (a : ℚ)
  have hSrat : S = (sRat : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [S]
    exact hsRat
  have hTotalRat : S + T = (totalRat : ℝ) := by
    rw [hST]
    dsimp [totalRat]
    norm_num
  have hTrat : T = (tRat : ℝ) := by
    calc
      T = S + T - S := by ring
      _ = (totalRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) := by rw [hTotalRat, hSrat]
      _ = (tRat : ℝ) := by simp [tRat]
  have hUrat : P + Q = (uRat : ℝ) := by
    calc
      P + Q = (c : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) - S * T := hUexpr
      _ = (c : ℚ) / (a : ℚ) - sRat * tRat := by
        rw [hSrat, hTrat]
        norm_num
      _ = (uRat : ℝ) := by simp [uRat]
  have hVrat : S * Q + T * P = (vRat : ℝ) := by
    rw [hVexpr]
    dsimp [vRat]
    norm_num
  have htne : (tRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply h.2
    dsimp [S, T] at hSrat hTrat ⊢
    have : (tRat : ℝ) = (sRat : ℝ) := by linarith
    linarith [hSrat, hTrat]
  refine fun hIrr => hIrr ?_
  refine ⟨(vRat - sRat * uRat) / (tRat - sRat), ?_⟩
  have hnum : (vRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) * (uRat : ℝ) = ((tRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ)) * P := by
    calc
      (vRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) * (uRat : ℝ)
          = (S * Q + T * P) - S * (P + Q) := by rw [← hVrat, ← hSrat, ← hUrat]
      _ = ((tRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ)) * P := by rw [← hTrat, ← hSrat]; ring
  have hcast : (((vRat - sRat * uRat) / (tRat - sRat) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      ((vRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ) * (uRat : ℝ)) / ((tRat : ℝ) - (sRat : ℝ)) := by
    norm_num
  rw [hcast]
  rw [hnum]
  field_simp [htne]
  dsimp [P]

import Mathlib


def IncreasingDifferences
    {X T : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] (f : X → T → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x' t - f x t ≤ f x' t' - f x t'

/-- Helper 1 — exchange inequality: increasing differences, rewritten as a
sum-swap inequality between the two diagonals on a `(x', x) × (t, t')` box. -/
lemma increasingDifferences_exchange
    {X T : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T]
    (f : X → T → ℝ) (h_inc : IncreasingDifferences f)
    {x x' : X} {t t' : T} (hxx' : x' ≤ x) (htt' : t ≤ t') :
    f x t + f x' t' ≤ f x' t + f x t' := by
  have h : f x t - f x' t ≤ f x t' - f x' t' := h_inc hxx' htt'
  linarith

/-- Helper 2 — uniqueness upgrades the maximizer bound to a strict one at any
other point. -/
lemma strict_lt_of_unique_max
    {X T : Type*} [LinearOrder X]
    (f : X → T → ℝ) {x : X} {t : T}
    (hx_max : ∀ y : X, f y t ≤ f x t)
    (hx_unique : ∀ y : X, f y t = f x t → y = x)
    {y : X} (hy : y ≠ x) : f y t < f x t := by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hx_max y) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (hx_unique y h) hy

/-- Assembled goal: Topkis monotone comparative statics with unique maximizers. -/
theorem topkis_monotone_unique_maximizers : ∀ {X T : Type*} [LinearOrder X] [Preorder T]
    (f : X → T → ℝ)
    (h_inc : IncreasingDifferences f)
    {x : X} {t : T} {x' : X} {t' : T}
    (hx_max : ∀ y : X, f y t ≤ f x t)
    (hx_unique : ∀ y : X, f y t = f x t → y = x)
    (hx'_max : ∀ y : X, f y t' ≤ f x' t')
    (hx'_unique : ∀ y : X, f y t' = f x' t' → y = x')
    (htt' : t ≤ t'), x ≤ x' := by
  intro X T _ _ f h_inc x t x' t' hx_max hx_unique hx'_max _ htt'
  by_contra hxx'
  push_neg at hxx'
  have hx'_le_x : x' ≤ x := le_of_lt hxx'
  have hx'_ne_x : x' ≠ x := ne_of_lt hxx'
  have h_exch : f x t + f x' t' ≤ f x' t + f x t' :=
    increasingDifferences_exchange f h_inc hx'_le_x htt'
  have h_strict : f x' t < f x t :=
    strict_lt_of_unique_max f hx_max hx_unique hx'_ne_x
  have h_max_t' : f x t' ≤ f x' t' := hx'_max x
  linarith
text_key: theorem _ : ∀ {X T : Type*} [LinearOrder X] [Preorder T] (b1 : X → T → ℝ) (b2 : IncreasingDifferences b1) {x : X} {t : T} {x' : X} {t' : T} (b3 : ∀ b0 : X, b1 b0 t ≤ b1 x t) (b4 : ∀ b0 : X, b1 b0 t = b1 x t → b0 = x) (b5 : ∀ b0 : X, b1 b0 t' ≤ b1 x' t') (b6 : ∀ b0 : X, b1 b0 t' = b1 x' t' → b0 = x') (b7 : t ≤ t'), x ≤ x'

/--
Let $a_j,b_j,c_j$ be integers for $1\leq j\leq N$. Assume for each $j$, at least one of
$a_j,b_j,c_j$ is odd. Show that there exist integers $r$, $s$, $t$ such that
$ra_j+sb_j+tc_j$ is odd for at least $4N/7$ values of $j$.
-/
theorem putnam_2000_b1
(N : ℕ)
(a b c : Fin N → ℤ)
(Nge1 : N ≥ 1)
(hodd : ∀ j : Fin N, Odd (a j) ∨ Odd (b j) ∨ Odd (c j))
: (∃ r s t : ℤ, {j : Fin N | Odd (r * a j + s * b j + t * c j)}.ncard ≥ (4 * N : ℝ) / 7) := by
  classical
  have _ := Nge1
  let P : Fin 7 → Fin N → Prop := fun k j => Odd (putnam2000b1Form k (a j) (b j) (c j))
  have hfour : ∀ j : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 7 => P k j).card = 4 := by
    intro j
    exact putnam2000b1_seven_form_count (a j) (b j) (c j) (hodd j)
  let C : Fin 7 → ℕ := fun k => (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin N => P k j).card
  have hsum : (∑ k : Fin 7, C k) = 4 * N := by
    calc
      (∑ k : Fin 7, C k)
          = ∑ k : Fin 7, ∑ j : Fin N, if P k j then 1 else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            change (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin N => P k j).card =
              ∑ j : Fin N, if P k j then 1 else 0
            rw [Finset.card_filter]
      _ = ∑ j : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin 7, if P k j then 1 else 0 := by
            exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ j : Fin N, 4 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            rw [← hfour j]
            rw [Finset.card_filter]
      _ = 4 * N := by
            simp [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.mul_comm]
  have haverage : ∃ k : Fin 7, (C k : ℝ) ≥ (4 * N : ℝ) / 7 := by
    have hle : (∑ k : Fin 7, ((4 * N : ℝ) / 7)) ≤ ∑ k : Fin 7, (C k : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Nat.cast_sum, hsum]
      norm_num
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl
    obtain ⟨k, _hk_mem, hk⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun _ : Fin 7 => (4 * N : ℝ) / 7) (g := fun k => (C k : ℝ)) (by simp) hle
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases haverage with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨putnam2000b1R k, putnam2000b1S k, putnam2000b1T k, ?_⟩
  have hcard :
      {j : Fin N | Odd (putnam2000b1R k * a j + putnam2000b1S k * b j + putnam2000b1T k * c j)}.ncard =
        C k := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
    simp [C, P, putnam2000b1_coeff_form]
  rw [hcard]
  exact hk

open Filter Topology

/--
Suppose $p$ is an odd prime. Prove that $\sum_{j=0}^p \binom{p}{j}\binom{p+j}{j} \equiv 2^p+1 \pmod{p^2}$.
-/

private lemma putnam_1991_b4_lucas_factor_one {p j : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hj : j < p) :
    (p + j).choose j ≡ 1 [MOD p] := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have h := Choose.choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat (n := p + j) (k := j) (p := p)
  have hmod1 : (p + j) % p = j := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mod_right]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj
  have hdiv1 : (p + j) / p = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.add_div_of_dvd_right (dvd_refl p)]
    rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hj, Nat.div_self hp.pos]
  have hmod2 : j % p = j := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj
  have hdiv2 : j / p = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hj
  simpa [hmod1, hdiv1, hmod2, hdiv2] using h

private lemma putnam_1991_b4_interior_term_modEq {p j : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Prime) (hj0 : j ≠ 0) (hjp : j < p) :
    p.choose j * (p + j).choose j ≡ p.choose j [MOD p ^ 2] := by
  have hchoose : p ∣ p.choose j := hp.dvd_choose_self hj0 hjp
  rcases hchoose with ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hfac : (p + j).choose j ≡ 1 [MOD p] :=
    putnam_1991_b4_lucas_factor_one hp hjp
  have hmul : p * (a * (p + j).choose j) ≡ p * (a * 1) [MOD p * p] := by
    exact (hfac.mul_left a).mul_left' p
  simpa [ha, pow_two, Nat.mul_assoc] using hmul

private lemma putnam_1991_b4_central_choose_modEq_two {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (2 * p).choose p ≡ 2 [MOD p ^ 2] := by
  rw [two_mul, Nat.add_choose_eq p p p]
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), p.choose i * p.choose (p - i)) ≡
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = p then 1 else 0)
          [MOD p ^ 2] := by
    apply Nat.ModEq.sum
    intro i hi
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · simpa [hi0] using (Nat.ModEq.refl 1 : 1 ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ 2])
    by_cases hip : i = p
    · simpa [hip] using (Nat.ModEq.refl 1 : 1 ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ 2])
    · have hile : i ≤ p := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      have hiplt : i < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hile hip
      have hp_i_ne : p - i ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hp_i_lt : p - i < p := by omega
      have hdiv1 : p ∣ p.choose i := hp.dvd_choose_self hi0 hiplt
      have hdiv2 : p ∣ p.choose (p - i) := hp.dvd_choose_self hp_i_ne hp_i_lt
      have hdiv : p ^ 2 ∣ p.choose i * p.choose (p - i) := by
        rw [pow_two]
        exact mul_dvd_mul hdiv1 hdiv2
      simpa [hi0, hip] using (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr hdiv)
  have htarget :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = p then 1 else 0)) = 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hp0 : 0 < p := hp.pos
    have hfirst :
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = p then 1 else 0)) = 1 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_single 0 ?_ ?_
      · intro b hb hb0
        have hbp : b ≠ p := by
          intro h
          have : p < p := by simpa [h] using Finset.mem_range.mp hb
          exact (lt_irrefl p) this
        simp [hb0, hbp]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot (by simpa using hp0)).elim
    simp [hfirst]
  exact hsum.trans (by rw [htarget])

theorem putnam_1991_b4
(p : ℕ)
(podd : Odd p)
(pprime : Prime p)
: (∑ j : Fin (p + 1), (p.choose j) * ((p + j).choose j)) ≡ (2 ^ p + 1) [MOD (p ^ 2)] := by
  have hpNat : Nat.Prime p := pprime.nat_prime
  have hpOdd_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    norm_num at podd
  have hterms :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), p.choose i * (p + i).choose i) ≡
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (p.choose i + if i = p then 1 else 0)
          [MOD p ^ 2] := by
    apply Nat.ModEq.sum
    intro i hi
    by_cases hip : i = p
    · have hc := putnam_1991_b4_central_choose_modEq_two hpNat
      simpa [hip, two_mul] using hc
    · by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · have h0p : (0 : ℕ) ≠ p := hpOdd_ne_zero.symm
        simpa [hi0, h0p] using (Nat.ModEq.refl 1 : 1 ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ 2])
      · have hile : i ≤ p := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have hiplt : i < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hile hip
        simpa [hip] using putnam_1991_b4_interior_term_modEq hpNat hi0 hiplt
  have htarget :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (p.choose i + if i = p then 1 else 0)) = 2 ^ p + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Nat.sum_range_choose]
    have hind : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (if i = p then 1 else 0)) = 1 := by
      simp
    rw [hind]
  rw [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range]
  have hfin :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1),
          if h : i < p + 1 then p.choose ↑(⟨i, h⟩ : Fin (p + 1)) *
            (p + ↑(⟨i, h⟩ : Fin (p + 1))).choose ↑(⟨i, h⟩ : Fin (p + 1))
          else 0)
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), p.choose i * (p + i).choose i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hlt : i < p + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    simp [hlt]
  rw [hfin]
  exact hterms.trans (by rw [htarget])

import Mathlib


abbrev ClaimSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

abbrev PaymentSchedule (ι : Type*) := ι → NNReal

def AbsolutePriority {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pay : PaymentSchedule ι) : Prop :=
  ∀ senior junior : ι, senior < junior → 0 < pay junior → pay senior = claims senior

noncomputable def SeniorClaimsBefore {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (i : ι) : NNReal := by
  classical
  exact ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < i), claims j

noncomputable def WaterfallDistribution {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Preorder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) : PaymentSchedule ι :=
  fun i => min (claims i) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims i)

theorem waterfall_positive_residual_of_positive_payment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal) (junior : ι)
    (hpos : 0 < WaterfallDistribution claims pool junior) :
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior < pool := by
  have hmin :
      0 < min (claims junior) (pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior) := by
    simpa [WaterfallDistribution] using hpos
  have hres : 0 < pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hmin (min_le_right _ _)
  exact tsub_pos_iff_lt.mp hres

theorem seniorClaim_le_juniorSeniorClaims
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (senior junior : ι) (hsj : senior < junior) :
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior ≤ SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior := by
  classical
  let s : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < senior)
  let t : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ι => j < junior)
  have hnot_mem : senior ∉ s := by
    simp [s]
  have hsubset : insert senior s ⊆ t := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hx
    simp only [t, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hsj
    · have hxlt : x < senior := by
        simpa [s] using hx
      exact lt_trans hxlt hsj
  have hsenior_eq : SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior = ∑ x ∈ s, claims x := by
    unfold SeniorClaimsBefore
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext x
      simp [s]
    · intro x hx
      rfl
  have hjunior_eq : SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior = ∑ x ∈ t, claims x := by
    unfold SeniorClaimsBefore
    apply Finset.sum_congr
    · ext x
      simp [t]
    · intro x hx
      rfl
  calc
    SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior =
        (∑ x ∈ s, claims x) + claims senior := by
          rw [hsenior_eq]
    _ = claims senior + ∑ x ∈ s, claims x := by
          rw [add_comm]
    _ = ∑ x ∈ insert senior s, claims x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert hnot_mem]
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, claims x := by
          exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsubset
            (fun x _ _ => zero_le (claims x))
    _ = SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior := by
          rw [hjunior_eq]

theorem nnreal_le_tsub_of_add_le_lt
    (a b c pool : NNReal) (hsum : a + b ≤ c) (hc : c < pool) :
    b ≤ pool - a := by
  have hle : b + a ≤ pool := by
    calc
      b + a = a + b := by rw [add_comm]
      _ ≤ c := hsum
      _ ≤ pool := le_of_lt hc
  have ha : a ≤ pool := by
    exact le_trans
      (by simpa [add_comm] using le_add_of_nonneg_left (show 0 ≤ b by exact zero_le b))
      hle
  exact (le_tsub_iff_right ha).2 hle

theorem waterfallDistribution_absolutePriority_of_linearOrder : ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (claims : ClaimSchedule ι) (pool : NNReal), AbsolutePriority claims (WaterfallDistribution claims pool) := by
  intro ι _ _ claims pool
  intro senior junior hsj hpos
  have hjunior_lt_pool :
      SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior < pool :=
    waterfall_positive_residual_of_positive_payment claims pool junior hpos
  have hsum :
      SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior + claims senior ≤ SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior :=
    seniorClaim_le_juniorSeniorClaims claims senior junior hsj
  have hclaim_le_residual :
      claims senior ≤ pool - SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior :=
    nnreal_le_tsub_of_add_le_lt
      (SeniorClaimsBefore claims senior) (claims senior)
      (SeniorClaimsBefore claims junior) pool hsum hjunior_lt_pool
  simp [WaterfallDistribution, min_eq_left hclaim_le_residual]

/--
Let $G$ be a finite set of real $n\times n$ matrices $\{M_i\}$, $1 \leq i \leq r$, which form a group under matrix
multiplication. Suppose that $\sum_{i=1}^r \mathrm{tr}(M_i)=0$, where $\mathrm{tr}(A)$ denotes the trace of the matrix $A$. Prove that $\sum_{i=1}^r M_i$ is the $n \times n$ zero matrix.
-/

theorem putnam_1985_b6 (n : ℕ)
(npos : n > 0)
(G : Finset (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
(groupG : (∀ g ∈ G, ∀ h ∈ G, g * h ∈ G) ∧ 1 ∈ G ∧ (∀ g ∈ G, ∃ h ∈ G, g * h = 1))
(hG : ∑ M ∈ G, Matrix.trace M = 0)
: (∑ M ∈ G, M = 0) := by
  classical
  let S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := ∑ M ∈ G, M
  have hmul_mem : ∀ g ∈ G, ∀ h ∈ G, g * h ∈ G := groupG.1
  have hone_mem : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ∈ G := groupG.2.1
  have hinv_right :
      ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ h ∈ G, g * h = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := groupG.2.2
  have htwo_sided :
      ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ h ∈ G,
        g * h = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ∧ h * g = 1 := by
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨h, hhG, hgh⟩ := hinv_right g hg
    obtain ⟨k, hkG, hhk⟩ := hinv_right h hhG
    have hkg : k = g := by
      calc
        k = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * k := by simp
        _ = (g * h) * k := by rw [hgh]
        _ = g * (h * k) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = g * 1 := by rw [hhk]
        _ = g := by simp
    have hhg : h * g = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
      simpa [hkg] using hhk
    exact ⟨h, hhG, hgh, hhg⟩
  have hleft_mul_sum :
      ∀ A ∈ G, A * S = S := by
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hAB, hBA⟩ := htwo_sided A hA
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_bij (fun M hM => A * M) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro M hM
      exact hmul_mem A hA M hM
    · intro M₁ hM₁ M₂ hM₂ hEq
      have hEq' := congr_arg (fun X => B * X) hEq
      calc
        M₁ = (B * A) * M₁ := by rw [hBA]; simp
        _ = B * (A * M₁) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = B * (A * M₂) := hEq'
        _ = (B * A) * M₂ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = M₂ := by rw [hBA]; simp
    · intro N hN
      refine ⟨B * N, hmul_mem B hB N hN, ?_⟩
      calc
        A * (B * N) = (A * B) * N := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * N := by rw [hAB]
        _ = N := by simp
    · intro M hM
      rfl
  have hS_mul : S * S = (G.card : ℝ) • S := by
    dsimp only [S]
    calc
      (∑ M ∈ G, M) * (∑ M ∈ G, M)
          = ∑ M ∈ G, M * (∑ M ∈ G, M) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ _M ∈ G, (∑ M ∈ G, M) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro M hM
            exact hleft_mul_sum M hM
      _ = (G.card : ℝ) • (∑ M ∈ G, M) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const]
            rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ G.card (∑ M ∈ G, M)]
  have htraceS : Matrix.trace S = 0 := by
    simpa [S, Matrix.trace_sum] using hG
  have hG_nonempty : G.Nonempty := ⟨1, hone_mem⟩
  have hcard_pos : 0 < G.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hG_nonempty
  have hcard_ne : (G.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hcard_pos)
  let c : ℝ := G.card
  let P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := c⁻¹ • S
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [c] using hcard_ne
  have hP_idem_matrix : P * P = P := by
    dsimp only [P]
    calc
      (c⁻¹ • S) * (c⁻¹ • S) = (c⁻¹ * c⁻¹) • (S * S) := by
        rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
      _ = (c⁻¹ * c⁻¹) • ((G.card : ℝ) • S) := by rw [hS_mul]
      _ = c⁻¹ • S := by
        simp [c, smul_smul, hcard_ne]
  have hP_idem : IsIdempotentElem (Matrix.toLin' P) := by
    change Matrix.toLin' P ∘ₗ Matrix.toLin' P = Matrix.toLin' P
    rw [← Matrix.toLin'_mul]
    exact congr_arg Matrix.toLin' hP_idem_matrix
  have htraceP : LinearMap.trace ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) (Matrix.toLin' P) = 0 := by
    simp [P, htraceS]
  have hproj : LinearMap.IsProj (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) (Matrix.toLin' P) :=
    (LinearMap.isProj_range_iff_isIdempotentElem (Matrix.toLin' P)).2 hP_idem
  have hfinrank_zero_real :
      (Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) : ℝ) = 0 := by
    rw [← hproj.trace]
    exact htraceP
  have hfinrank_zero :
      Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hfinrank_zero_real
  have hrange_bot : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P) = ⊥ := by
    exact (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero).mp hfinrank_zero
  have hP_zero_lin : Matrix.toLin' P = 0 := by
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hrange_bot
  have hP_zero : P = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    simpa using hP_zero_lin
  have hS_zero : S = 0 := by
    calc
      S = c • P := by
        simp [P, smul_smul, hc_ne]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hP_zero, smul_zero]
  simpa [S] using hS_zero

import Mathlib


def OrdinalSingleCrossing
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x x' : X⦄ ⦃t t' : T⦄,
    x ≤ x' → t ≤ t' → f x t ≤ f x' t → f x t' ≤ f x' t'

def QuasiSupermodular
    {X α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder α]
    (g : X → α) : Prop :=
  (∀ x y : X, g (x ⊓ y) ≤ g x → g y ≤ g (x ⊔ y)) ∧
    (∀ x y : X, g (x ⊓ y) < g x → g y < g (x ⊔ y))

def IsGlobalMax {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) (x : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ y : X, g y ≤ g x

def ArgmaxSet {X α : Type*} [Preorder α] (g : X → α) : Set X :=
  {x | IsGlobalMax g x}

def ParametricArgmaxSet
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder α] (f : X → T → α) (t : T) : Set X :=
  ArgmaxSet (fun x : X => f x t)

def ParametricArgmaxNonempty
    {X T α : Type*} [Preorder α] (f : X → T → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : T, (ParametricArgmaxSet f t).Nonempty

def IsSublatticeSet
    {X : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] (A : Set X) : Prop :=
  (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊓ y ∈ A) ∧
    (∀ ⦃x y : X⦄, x ∈ A → y ∈ A → x ⊔ y ∈ A)

structure OrdinalTopkisObjective
    (X T α : Type*) [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α] where
  objective : X → T → α
  quasiSupermodular_section : ∀ t : T, QuasiSupermodular (fun x : X => objective x t)
  single_crossing : OrdinalSingleCrossing objective
  argmax_nonempty : ParametricArgmaxNonempty objective

theorem quasiSupermodular_parametricArgmaxSet_isSublatticeSet : ∀ {X T α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup X] [SemilatticeInf X] [Preorder T] [Preorder α]
    (F : OrdinalTopkisObjective X T α) (t : T), IsSublatticeSet (ParametricArgmaxSet F.objective t) := by
  intro X T α _ _ _ _ F t
  let g : X → α := fun x : X => F.objective x t
  have hqs : QuasiSupermodular g := F.quasiSupermodular_section t
  constructor
  · intro x y hx hy
    dsimp [ParametricArgmaxSet, ArgmaxSet, IsGlobalMax] at hx hy ⊢
    intro z
    have hmeet_le_x : g (x ⊓ y) ≤ g x := hx (x ⊓ y)
    have hx_le_meet : g x ≤ g (x ⊓ y) := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt : g (x ⊓ y) < g x := lt_of_le_not_ge hmeet_le_x hnot
      have hy_lt_join : g y < g (x ⊔ y) := hqs.2 x y hlt
      exact hy_lt_join.not_ge (hy (x ⊔ y))
    exact le_trans (hx z) hx_le_meet
  · intro x y hx hy
    dsimp [ParametricArgmaxSet, ArgmaxSet, IsGlobalMax] at hx hy ⊢
    intro z
    have hmeet_le_x : g (x ⊓ y) ≤ g x := hx (x ⊓ y)
    have hy_le_join : g y ≤ g (x ⊔ y) := hqs.1 x y hmeet_le_x
    exact le_trans (hy z) hy_le_join
